# FDG3035

> DO NOT give types names that would conflict with any type in the core namespaces.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.4.1.3 Core Namespaces.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Core namespaces are all System namespaces except application model namespaces and infrastructure namespaces (such as `*.Design` and `*.Permissions`), for example System, System.IO, System.Xml, and System.Net. CA1724 does not check this rule: it compares type names with namespace names, not with the types of the core namespaces (a type named Stream or EventLog is not reported; probe with SDK 10.0.402).

## From the book

For example, never use `Stream` as a type name. It would conflict with `System.IO.Stream`, a very commonly used type.

By the same token, do not add a type named `EventLog` to the `System.Diagnostics.Events` namespace, because the `System.Diagnostics` namespace already contains a type named `EventLog`.
